member.name: T:Bosak.Schema.IXsdValidationService
member.summary: Add-on validation service contract (REQ-009 S2): evaluates the recorded XSD 1.1 assertion components of a compiled schema against a candidate element and reports explicit findings.
member.remarks: S2 evaluates every recorded xs:assert () against the supplied candidate element; S3 evaluates the xs:assertion facets () of a named simple type against a lexical value via . The W3C-constrained assertion environment is enforced add-side (XPath 2.0 compatibility, captured namespace bindings, forbidden-function pre-screen) per ADR-005 decision 3; facets additionally receive the typed value as context item and through $value. REQ-009 S4a adds — static compilation checking of the recorded xs:alternative test expressions under the same constrained environment (CTA applicability evaluation itself is S4b).

member.name: M:Bosak.Schema.IXsdValidationService.Validate(Bosak.Schema.ICompiledSchema,System.Xml.Linq.XElement)
member.summary: Evaluates the xs:assert assertions applicable to and returns the aggregated outcome. REQ-009 S4b governing-type semantics: an explicit xsi:type pre-empts; otherwise the owning declaration's xs:alternative tests run in document order (first match selects its type, the test-less default alternative catches the remainder, and no match without a default is an explicit BSK-XSD-015); otherwise the declared type governs. Only assertions owned by the governing named type — or, for anonymous inline complex types, owned by the candidate's element declaration — are evaluated.
member.param: A schema produced by against .
The element to validate. Its child content is what the assertion expressions see.
member.returns: A ; invalid when any applicable assertion is violated, refused, or errors, or when CTA fails.
